definition_en: to join two pieces of metal by melting brass between them
core_image: 黄铜在火焰里熔成一线亮液，把两块钢铁牢牢咬合
scene: 修理铺里师傅把两根钢管对齐，火焰枪喷出蓝火。The mechanic will braze the two steel pipes together with a brass rod.
sceneCN: 这里 braze 是「铜焊、钎焊」（第 1 个义项：用黄铜做钎料把金属接合）；句意是师傅用黄铜焊条把两根钢管焊在一起。

pos.zh: 用黄铜钎焊；铜焊（金属件）

derivatives.zh: 由动词加 -ing 构成，义为「钎焊工艺」
由动词加 -er 构成，义为「做铜焊的工人」

senses.title: To join metal with brass
senses.definition: to join two pieces of metal by melting a brass filler between them
senses.definitionCN: 熔化黄铜做填料，把两块金属接合在一起
senses.example: He brazed the broken bracket back onto the frame.
senses.exampleCN: 他把断裂的托架铜焊回车架上。
senses.why: The craft is named after the brass filler that melts and grips the parts.
senses.whyCN: 这门手艺以黄铜填料命名：铜液熔化后把两块金属咬住。

senses.title: To carry out brazing work
senses.definition: to work as a welder using brass filler and a torch
senses.definitionCN: 以喷枪和黄铜填料进行焊接作业
senses.example: The apprentice learned to braze before touching the arc welder.
senses.exampleCN: 学徒先学铜焊，才允许碰电弧焊机。
senses.why: Once the material defines the craft, the verb widens to the activity itself.
senses.whyCN: 材料定义了手艺之后，动词自然扩展到整项作业活动。

senses.title: To repair by brazing
senses.definition: to fix a cracked metal object by brazing over the crack
senses.definitionCN: 在裂缝上钎焊黄铜，把损坏的金属件修好
senses.example: Grandpa brazed the leak in the old kettle.
senses.exampleCN: 爷爷用铜焊补好了旧水壶的漏缝。
senses.why: A joining action applied to damage becomes a repair action.
senses.whyCN: 接合的动作落在破损处，就从「连接」长出「修补」的含义。

intro.en: Braze goes back through Old French and Latin to a word for brass.
intro.cn: braze 经古法语和拉丁语追溯到一个表示「黄铜」的词。

items.en: aes and its derived form meant copper or brass.
items.cn: 拉丁语 aes 及其派生形式指铜或黄铜。

items.en: a reconstructed form brasa is thought to have meant glowing coals.
items.cn: 一般认为通俗拉丁语的重构形式 brasa 指烧红的炭。

items.en: braser meant to burn or to work with hot brass.
items.cn: 古法语 braser 意为灼烧或加工烧红的黄铜。

items.en: English took the word as braze, naming the craft of joining with brass.
items.cn: 英语在十六至十七世纪借入 braze，命名用黄铜接合的工艺。

items.en: braze is the standard technical verb for brazing, next to welding and soldering.
items.cn: 如今 braze 是钎焊的标准术语，与电焊、锡焊相区别。

note.en: Braze is easy to confuse with blaze, and it belongs to a family of metal-joining verbs.
note.cn: braze 极易与 blaze 混淆，同时也和一组金属接合动词同场出现。

entries.definitionCN: 熊熊燃烧；只是拼写相近，词源不同
黄铜制的；引申为厚颜无耻的，与 braze 同出黄铜一词根

entries.definition: the yellow copper-zinc alloy used as the brazing filler
entries.definitionCN: 黄铜，铜锌合金，正是 braze 所用的填料

entries.definition: to join metals by melting the metals themselves
entries.definitionCN: 熔化母材本身把金属焊在一起，温度更高

entries.definition: to join metals with a soft low-melting alloy
entries.definitionCN: 用低熔点软合金锡焊，温度更低

normalIntro.en: Use the shared root of brass and brazen to remember braze.
normalIntro.cn: 借助 brass 和 brazen 的同根关系来记 braze。

normal.en: Braze contains brass by sound: BRAss to BRAze.
normal.cn: braze 与 brass 声音相近：黄铜料，铜焊接。

normal.en: Brazen means brass-faced, from the same root.
normal.cn: brazen（厚脸皮）原义「黄铜脸」，与 braze 同根。

normal.en: The filler melts, so braze rhymes with blaze of the torch.
normal.cn: 焊枪的火焰一闪（blaze），黄铜熔化即钎焊（braze）。

normal.en: B-R-A-Z: Brass Rod Adds Zip to the joint.
normal.cn: 黄铜焊条（Brass Rod）给接头加上韧劲，取首字母 B-R-A-Z。

normal.en: Weld melts the base, solder is soft, braze sits in between.
normal.cn: 电焊熔母材，锡焊用软料，铜焊居其间。

abstract.en: Picture a river of glowing brass stitching two steel plates.
abstract.cn: 想象一条发光的黄铜小河把两块钢板缝合。

abstract.en: Feel the torch flame wrapping the joint like a bracelet.
abstract.cn: 感觉喷枪火焰像手镯一样环住接头。

abstract.en: The seam cools from cherry red to steel grey in one breath.
abstract.cn: 焊缝由樱红一瞬冷却成钢灰。

examples.en: The workshop brazed the copper fittings onto the pipe.
examples.cn: 车间把铜配件钎焊到管子上。

examples.en: He learned to braze with a torch before he was fifteen.
examples.cn: 他十五岁前就学会了用喷枪铜焊。

examples.en: A careful braze can be as strong as a weld on thin tubing.
examples.cn: 精细的钎焊在薄壁管上可以和电焊一样牢固。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「布瑞兹」——像把黄铜「布」满接缝，火一「瑞」出，铜液「兹兹」作响，焊口便成了。

root: 一般认为源自通俗拉丁语 brasa（烧红的炭），与德语 Brand（燃烧）同源；经古法语 braser 进入英语。核心词形是拉丁语 aes（铜），词义核心为「以黄铜施热接合」。

sensesIntro.en: From the craft of joining with brass, the verb widens to the activity and then to repair.
sensesIntro.cn: 从「用黄铜接合」的工艺出发，动词扩展到整项作业，再长出修补之义。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: molten brass gripping two pieces of steel.
core.cn: 核心意象：熔化的黄铜把两块钢铁咬合在一起。

intro.en: Braze is a single-morpheme verb, so its family is built by adding suffixes.
intro.cn: braze 是单语素动词，其词族靠加后缀扩展。

latinIntro.en: The root traces to Latin aes, copper, through a Vulgar Latin form for glowing coals.
latinIntro.cn: 词根经通俗拉丁语「烧红的炭」上溯到拉丁语 aes（铜）。

items.meaning: to shape metal by heat and hammering
